page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.12xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by AWS Graviton ARMv9 processors. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, the server features 48 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Neoverse-V3 microarchitecture running at 2.8 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 2850 GB of NVMe SSD instance store capacity, and it supports a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-core capabilities and exceptional memory performance. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in PassMark memory tests and database operations, alongside 136.39 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. Single-threaded gzip compression and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also reached top-tier performance categories. However, while prompt processing for a small 135M LLM model scored in the top tier at 4218.03 tokens per second, text generation for the same model was rated as poor at 31.56 tokens per second, indicating a potential bottleneck in sequential text generation workloads.

The qualitative cost efficiency of the m9gd.12xlarge is driven by its high resource density, combining dedicated ARM64 cores with integrated NVMe SSD storage. This configuration eliminates the need for external storage attachments for high-throughput local operations, optimizing the resource-to-cost ratio. The server is suited for database hosting, redis caching, static web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring high memory bandwidth and fast local storage.
